title: LMOD+: A Comprehensive Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Developing and Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Ophthalmology

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models to predict a patient's sex directly from ophthalmic imaging in a zero-shot setting to determine if the models can extract demographic attributes that might be used as proxies for biased clinical decision-making.

Prompting models to predict a patient's age group directly from ophthalmic imaging in a zero-shot setting to determine if the models can extract age attributes that could improperly influence medical inferences.
